[[Music cape]] |music = [[Rellekka (music track)|Rellekka]] |map = {{Map|name=Rellekka|x=2658|y=3677|height=300|width=300|zoom=1}} |type = settlement |leagueRegion = Fremennik }} [[File:Rellekka icon detail.png|left|130px]] {{Relativelocation |location = Rellekka |north = Etceteria |west = Waterbirth Island |south = Sinclair Mansion |east = Mountain Camp }} '''Rellekka''' is a village in the [[Fremennik Province]]. It is home to the [[Fremennik]]s, a hardy people who place great value on tradition. Nearly all of its features require completion of [[The Fremennik Trials]] to use. Multiple [[quests]] take place in the area and its surroundings. ==Transportation== Rellekka's remote location makes it a very tedious place to access. However, there are a number of ways to reach Rellekka, listed here in order of least to most running involved: * {{Plink|Fremennik sea boots 1}} — centre of the marketplace. * {{Plink|Enchanted lyre}} — southern village entrance. * {{Plink|Waterbirth Teleport}} — Waterbirth Island, next to a boat leading to the Rellekka docks. * {{Plink|Teleport to House}} — [[Portal (Player-owned house)|POH portal]] just south of the village. * {{Plink|Construct. cape|txt=Construction cape}} or {{Plink|Rellekka teleport}} — just outside the house portal. * {{Plink|Achievement diary cape|txt=Diary cape}} — just south of the POH portal. * {{Plink|Icy basalt}} — [[Weiss]], after which players can climb down the cliff and take the boat to a dock north-east of the village. * {{Plink|Moonclan Teleport}} and the {{Plink|Lunar Home Teleport}} — [[Lunar Isle]], after which talking to one of the [[NPC]]s without a [[Seal of Passage]] will cause players to be instantly kicked out to the Rellekka marketplace. **With the [[elite Fremennik Diary]] completed, the [[Return Orb]] in Lunar Isle's bank can be used instead. * {{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{Fairycode|DKS}} — [[Keldagrim]] cave, a short run east of the northern village entrance. * {{Plink|Ring of wealth}} — [[Miscellania]], a medium-short run northwest of the docks. * {{Plink|Music cape}} — [[Falo the Bard]], a medium run south of the village. * {{Plink|Spirit trees|pic=Spirit tree (Construction) icon}} — [[Etceteria]], a decent run to the docks to Rellekka. With the 55 [[Agility]] shortcut, this is as fast as the POH teleport. * {{Plink|Eagle transport system|pic=Giant eagle (interface item)}} — [[Rellekka Hunter area]] cave, a long run northeast of the village. * {{Plink|Camelot Teleport}} — Camelot, a very long run south of the village. ==History== At some point in the [[Fourth Age]] or early [[Fifth Age]], the [[Fremennik]] people abandoned their nomadic way of life, creating the village of Rellekka. While this greatly improved life for most Fremennik, some disagreed with this new way of living. They wanted to live closer to nature, and felt like the people of Rellekka had grown too complacent and too reliant on tools rather than skill. They also disagreed with the use of magic and felt that their [[Peer the Seer|seer]] was an affront to the gods, although both groups do share the same views on the sanctity of runestones.{{CiteNPC|npc=Hamal the Chieftain|quote=We left Rellekka because we wanted to live closer to nature. We feel that the people of Rellekka have grown complacent and rely too much on their tools rather than their skill. And while they share our view on the sanctity of the runestones, they still employ and actively use magic. Their Seer is an affront to the gods!|loc=Mountain Daughter}} These people left the Fremenniks, grouping together to form the [[Mountain Tribe]], taking with them the [[Ancient Rock]] that symbolized the Fremennik's refusal to use runestones.{{CiteNPC|npc=Brundt the Chieftain|quote=When their group split off from Rellekka, they stole one of the ancient relics of the Fremennik. Our ancient rock.{{nbsp}}[...] It symbolised our refusal to use the runestones for ourselves, instead relying on our own abilities. The people you speak of took the stone with them when they left for the mountains. They claimed their way of living was more pure and closer to nature.|loc=Mountain Daughter}} The Fremenniks would later establish more settlements across the [[Fremennik Province]], forming colonies on [[Miscellania]],{{CiteNPC|npc=Hamal the Chieftain|quote=Oh yes... that group left the mainland a long time ago. And good riddance to them, I say.|loc=Mountain Daughter|notes=|name=}}{{CiteNews|author=RuneScape|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/throne-of-miscellania|title=Throne Of Miscellania|newsdate=29 November 2004|notes=|name=}} [[Etceteria]], and the [[Fremennik Isles]].{{CiteNPC|npc=Maria Gunnars|quote=Their names were Jatizso and Neitiznot.}}{{CiteNPC|npc=Mord Gunnars|quote=As punishment for their squabbling he banished his sons from his realm, ordering that neither should return until they had conquered lands of their own.}} ==Locations== All features require [[The Fremennik Trials]], with the exception of milking the [[dairy cow]] or using the [[dairy churn]]. [[Sigmund the Merchant]] sells a variety of goods in a general store-like shop, which is not marked on the world map. === Buildings === {| class="wikitable" !Building !Description |- |[[Borrokar]]'s home |A moderate home with a nice twin bed. |- |[[Freidir]] and [[Inga]]'s home |A home near the longhall, with a permanent fire. |- |[[Freygerd]] and [[Reeso]]'s home |A home near a sandpit, which gets visited by a baby [[Basilisk Youngling|basilisk]]. |- |[[Jennella]]'s home |A small house with a permanent fire. |- |[[Lanzig]]'s home |A small home with a chicken pen behind it. |- |[[Lensa]]'s home |A small house near the entrance to the village. |- |[[Peer the Seer]]'s house |The largest house in the village. |- |[[Pontak]]'s home |A small home with a small farm behind it containing [[cabbage]], [[onion]]s, and [[potato]]es. |- |Rellekka longhall |A large longhall featuring a bar, tables, and a stage. |- |Rellekka workshop |A workshop containing a [[furnace]], a [[Pottery Oven|pottery oven]], a [[spinning wheel]], a [[Potter's Wheel|potter's wheel]], and three [[Anvil|anvils]]. |- |[[Sassilik]]'s home |Home of Sassilik, containing a lockpick-able chest. |- |Storage hut |A large storage hut north of the farm. |- |Storage shed |A small storage shed attached to the farm. |- |[[Swensen the Navigator|Swensen]]'s house |A moderately sized home with a maze underneath it. |- |[[Thorvald the Warrior|Thorvald]]'s home |A small home with a loft, and a massive combat dungeon beneath it. |- |[[Yrsa's Accoutrements]] |A shop selling a large array of Fremennik clothing. |} === The port === [[File:Rellekka marketplace.png|thumb|right|300px|The marketplace of Rellekka.]] [[File:Rellekka docks.png|thumb|right|300px|The sea port of Rellekka.]] Rellekka, being built next to the sea, has a thriving port. Ships travel to and from Rellekka regularly. From Rellekka it is possible to travel to: *[[Miscellania]] and [[Etceteria]] — Only accessible after completion of [[The Fremennik Trials]]. Points of interest include the bank, castle marketplaces, underground shops, and the Manage Your Kingdom mini-game. *[[Lunar Isle]] — Requires part of [[Lunar Diplomacy]]. To go here, you must first travel to the Pirates' Cove. Points of interest include the bank, [[Astral Altar]], gem mines, and [[flax]] fields. *[[Pirates' Cove]] — Requires part of Lunar Diplomacy. Points of interest include [[swamp tar]] respawns and [[moss giant]]s. *[[Waterbirth Island]] — Points of interest include [[snape grass]] respawns, [[rock crab]]s, and [[Waterbirth Dungeon]]. *[[The Fremennik Isles]] — Also known as [[Neitiznot]] and [[Jatizso]]. Jatizso requires a small amount of the [[Fremennik Isles]] quest, while Neitiznot requires a little more. The quest is started on the docks. Points of interest include [[yak]]s, the [[spinning wheel]], [[Jatizso Mines]], [[ice troll]]s, anvils, two banks, a tannery, several shops, a furnace, range, and water source. *[[Iceberg]] — Although technically not part of Rellekka's port, the [[Boat (Larry)|small boat]] east of Rellekka will take players to the Penguin Outpost, home to the [[Penguin agility course]]. *[[Ungael]] — During and after [[Dragon Slayer II]], players may fight [[Vorkath]] on this island, only accessible through the port [[Torfinn]] is on. *The [[Island of Stone]] — After completing [[The Fremennik Exiles]], players can return to this island to fight [[Basilisk Knight]]s, as well as regular [[basilisk]]s and [[dagannoth]]. === Skill training areas === * There is a firepit in the main lodge that never dies out. Players buying or fishing for fish can cook them here. There is also a [[dairy cow]] and churn to make milk into dairy products like [[butter]], [[cream]], or [[cheese]]. * In the marketplace are many [[thieving]] spots, including three [[Fish stall|fish stalls]] and two [[Fur stall|fur stalls]]. There is also a Fremennik wandering around that can be pickpocketed. Beware that the stalls are heavily guarded by Rellekka's [[market guard]]s. The village also contains pickable chests with loot such as [[runes]] and [[coins]]. * Within Rellekka, it is possible to catch [[shrimp]], [[sardine]]s, [[herring]], [[anchovies]], [[mackerel]], [[cod]], [[tuna]], [[lobster]], [[bass]], [[swordfish]], and [[shark]]. While [[big net]] [[fishing]], it is also possible to get [[seaweed]] (useful in [[Crafting]]), [[leather boots]], [[leather gloves]], and [[casket]]s. The fish trader in the marketplace will buy and sell raw fish, as well as fishing supplies such as bait. * To the north-east of the longhall is a [[mining]] area containing seven [[coal]], four [[clay]], and three [[silver rocks]] though this spot is not recommended due to the lack of a nearby bank. However, there is a [[furnace]] and an [[anvil]] just on the other side of the village, in the south-west corner. By using the well and pottery features west of the marketplace, it is possible to craft any clay item within Rellekka. If you build your [[house]] there, you can also craft [[Magic tablet|tele-tablets]] here. It is also possible to craft glass without ever leaving the area, as there are seaweed spawns, a sandpit, and a furnace within the village. * [[Flax]] grows just south of the village. The [[spinning wheel]] in Rellekka allows players to make [[bowstring]] without leaving the area. * The [[Rellekka Rooftop Course]] can be accessed with level 80 Agility, rewarding 780 experience for each successful lap (increased to 920 after completing the [[Fremennik Diary|Fremennik Hard Diary]]). Perfect runs can net up to 55,000 experience per hour, 65,000 per hour with diary completion. With level 85 Agility players will stop failing the course, meaning the Rellekka course offers greater experience per hour than the [[Prifddinas]] course until around level 89. * The nearby [[Rellekka Hunter area]] hosts a large variety of creatures to capture and is one of the largest hunter spots. In Rellekka, there is a fur merchant who will buy all hunter fur. There also seems to be a large amount of [[implings]] in the area, particularly on the path to the south of the village. ==Sailing info== Players can [[mooring point|dock]] at Rellekka with level 62 [[Sailing]], provided they have also completed [[The Fremmenik Trials]]. The largest dock in the centre of the village offers the following utilities for sailors, though many are unusable until the quest is completed: *[[File:Shipwright map icon.png|link=Shipwright]] [[Shipwright]] *[[File:Port task board icon.png|link=Notice board]] [[Notice board]] *[[File:Salvaging station map icon.png|link=Salvaging station]] [[Salvaging station]] *[[File:Ledger table icon.png|link=Ledger table]] [[Ledger table]] ===Port tasks=== The notice board offers eight [[port tasks]] selected from the following lists. '''[[Bounty tasks]]''' {{BountyTaskList|location=Rellekka}} '''[[Courier tasks]]''' {{CourierTaskList|location=Rellekka}} ==Inhabitants== [[File:Rellekka entrance.png|thumb|300px|The guarded entrance to the village.]] === Personalities === * {{Chatl|Agnar}}, a councilmember who tries to exile the player. * {{Chatl|Askeladden}}, a young boy who dreams of becoming a Fremennik warrior and gives players the [[pet rock]]. * {{Chatl|Blanin}}, Dron's brother. * {{Chatl|Bjorn}}, a very drunk man in the longhall. * {{Chatl|Brundt the Chieftain}}, chieftain of the [[Fremennik]] tribe and a key character in many local [[quests]]. * {{Chatl|Council workman}}, who repaired the bridge to the village. * {{Chatl|Dron}}, a paranoid Fremennik who talks in riddles. * {{Chatl|Eldgrim}}, a drunk man found at the longhall bar. * {{Chatl|Fish monger}}, who buys and sells fish from a number of stalls in the marketplace. * {{Chatl|Fridgeir}}, a highly critical audience member in the longhall. * {{Chatl|Fur trader (Rellekka)|text=Fur trader}}, who buys and sells fur. * {{Chatl|Inga}}, a disapproving councilmember. * {{Chatl|Ingrid Hradson}}, Olaf Hradson's wife. * {{Chatl|Jarvald}}, a mighty Fremennik huntsman who will take players to [[Waterbirth Island]], the home of the mighty [[Dagannoth Kings]]. * {{Chatl|Jennella}}, a citizen of the village. * {{Chatl|Lalli}}, a paranoid troll cook. * {{Chatl|Larry}}, a seemingly-insane naturalist obsessed with penguins. * {{Chatl|Lensa}}, a citizen of the village. * {{Chatl|Lokar Searunner}}, a pirate who will take players to the [[Pirates' Cove]] if they have a [[Seal of Passage]]. * {{Chatl|Longhall bouncer|pic=Longhall Bouncer chathead}}, who protects the backstage entrance to the longhall stage. * {{Chatl|Manni the Reveller}}, a warrior who spends most of his time drinking in the longhall. He is said to be unbeatable in a drinking contest. * {{Chatl|Maria Gunnars}}, who will ferry players to [[Neitiznot]]. She is Mord Gunnars' wife. * {{Chatl|Mord Gunnars}}, who will take players to [[Jatizso]]. He is Maria Gunnars' husband * {{Chatl|Olaf the Bard}}, a loyal bard of the Fremenniks who knows the secret of the Fremennik [[lyre]]. * {{Chatl|Olaf Hradson}}, a [[Fremennik]] who wants (but has failed) to be a treasure hunter * {{Chatl|Ospak}}, a non-sober audience member in the longhall. * {{Chatl|Peer the Seer}}, a seer who can see the future and can also help you make [[Skeletal armour]]. After completion of the [[Fremennik Diary#Easy|Easy Fremennik Diary]] he acts as a bank deposit box. * {{Chatl|Sailor}}, an unnamed man who will take you to [[Miscellania]] and [[Etceteria]]. * {{Chatl|Sassilik}}, a disapproving councilmember. * {{Chatl|Sigli the Huntsman}}, A hunter who seeks to slay [[The Draugen]]. He can help you make [[Spined armour]]. * {{Chatl|Sigmund the Merchant|pic=Sigmund The Merchant chathead}}, who sells his wares in the marketplace. * {{Chatl|Skulgrimen}}, a warrior who sells [[Fremennik helmets]] and [[Warhammer|warhammers]]. He can also help you make [[rock-shell armour]]. * {{Chatl|Styrmir}}, an audience member who criticizes players who play the lyre. * {{Chatl|Swensen the Navigator}}, The Fremennik's greatest navigator. His name consists entirely of compass points. * {{Chatl|Torbrund}}, who sits in the longhall audience. * {{Chatl|Thora the Barkeep}}, the barmaid of the longhall who once travelled the world and invented exotic drinks. * {{Chatl|Volf Olafson}}, a young boy who awaits his father, [[Olaf Hradson]]'s, return. * {{Chatl|Yrsa}}, who sells a large variety of clothing and will also change your default boots. ===Monsters and attackable NPCs=== * [[Bear Cub|Bear cub]] (x4) * [[Black unicorn]] (x2) * [[Black unicorn Foal|Black unicorn foal]] (x4) * [[Borrokar]] * [[Bunny]] (x8) * [[Chicken]]
